final: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color,'(none)') color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) amt FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id=ili.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color,'(none)')), t AS (SELECT AVG(amt) a, SUM(amt) s FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.amt) AS avg_invoiced, AVG(c.amt/t.s) AS avg_share, AVG(c.amt-t.a) AS avg_above_average FROM c, t WHERE c.amt > t.a
